as_told.title: Matthew Brown smeared by ODNI and saying humans are a resource

plain: A former government official named Matthew Brown is said to have stated that people may be a resource for non-human intelligence, meaning beings not from humanity. Michels brings this up twice, recalling it from an interview Brown gave the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell on Corbell's show Weaponized, and adds that Brown was smeared by the Office of the Director of National Intelligence, which oversees US spy agencies. If true, it would mean someone inside government believes humans are being used by something else.
